first_impression.reaction: I typed 'santorini wedding packages' on the train. First line is a little clever, but the second sentence tells me what's usually in one and the third tells me where they differ. That's my answer straight away. The four takeaways are tight, so I'd read those, jump to 'What packages often leave out', screenshot the comparison checklist and check the FAQ.

journey.quote: Most bundle a ceremony space, its set-up, a coordinator and a set number of hours in that space.
journey.reaction: There it is, second sentence. Exactly what I searched for, no wading.

journey.quote: Several Santorini venues require a wedding planner on top of the venue fee, which changes what a package is really worth to you.
journey.reaction: Didn't know that. This is the bullet I'd actually remember.

journey.section: What a Santorini wedding package covers
journey.quote: The word "package" tells you a venue has grouped some things together. It does not tell you which.
journey.reaction: Good line. Then three shapes in a short list. Easy to scan on my phone.

journey.section: Ceremony space, set-up and a coordinator
journey.quote: That hire includes a white altar table, chandelier, lanterns, white Tiffany chairs, a sound system, guest and accessible facilities and a bridal suite.
journey.reaction: The section opens with a nice one-line summary, then it's hotel after hotel of long inclusion lists. Chandeliers and Tiffany chairs, on a tiny screen. I start thumbing past.

journey.section: Ceremony space, set-up and a coordinator
journey.quote: Its [Rental Packages 2026](https://santorinigem.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/SANTORINI-GEM_RENTAL-PACKAGES_2026.pdf) list a morning Ceremony Wedding Terrace Exclusive Hire, with the event from 10.30am to 11.30am and the bridal room from 10.15am.
journey.reaction: 2026 in the document name. So yes, this is current. That answers my 'is this still true' question.

journey.section: Reception, menus and drinks where the venue states them
journey.quote: Food and drink are where packages most often stop.
journey.reaction: Straight to the point. Good to know before I get excited by a package name.

journey.section: Reception, menus and drinks where the venue states them
journey.quote: The Andronis package itself adds floral decor for the ceremony, a bridal bouquet and boutonniere, a two-tier wedding cake, a bottle of sparkling wine with chocolate-covered strawberries, a private cliffside ceremony area, Andronis Heart koufeta favours, a symbolic gift and a romantic turndown with sparkling wine and strawberries.
journey.reaction: One sentence, nine items, in a section about food and drink. I lose track of what's the menu and what's the package.

journey.section: Are Santorini wedding packages all inclusive?
journey.quote: Rarely, in the sense most couples mean.
journey.reaction: Heading is literally my next question and the answer is the first word. Love it.

journey.quote: Do you have to book rooms to secure the package? At Canaves, often yes.
journey.reaction: Question heading style, short answer first. Three-night minimums is the kind of catch I'd want to know.

journey.section: How to compare two Santorini quotes like for like
journey.quote: Once both quotes answer the same questions, the real difference between them is usually obvious.
journey.reaction: The bold checklist above this is the thing I'd screenshot and bookmark the page for.

journey.quote: The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade can issue a CNI in Australia, but some local authorities accept only CNIs issued in their own country, so ask the destination's embassy or consulate which applies.
journey.reaction: All Australian. Not my country, so I skip it. Fine, but it's a long stretch of page that isn't for me.

journey.section: For Australian couples: currency, deposits and insurance
journey.quote: For Australian couples: currency, deposits and insurance
journey.reaction: Labelled honestly, so I scroll past. Makes me wonder if the whole site is only for Australians.

journey.quote: Some do, and some require it.
journey.reaction: Short answer up front, then examples. Exactly how an FAQ should read.

unanswered_questions: Roughly what does a Santorini wedding package cost? Even a ballpark. There's no price anywhere.
Does Wedded Wonderland work with couples outside Australia, or is this only for Australians?
Which of these venues is best if I only want a quick yes or no on a couple-only package?

turn_offs_found.quote: That hire includes a white altar table, chandelier, lanterns, white Tiffany chairs, a sound system, guest and accessible facilities and a bridal suite.
turn_offs_found.why: The 'Ceremony space, set-up and a coordinator' section runs as long venue-by-venue paragraphs packed with item lists. On a phone I can't compare them; I'd want a short table or two-line summary per venue, with the full lists tucked below.

turn_offs_found.quote: The Andronis package itself adds floral decor for the ceremony, a bridal bouquet and boutonniere, a two-tier wedding cake, a bottle of sparkling wine with chocolate-covered strawberries, a private cliffside ceremony area, Andronis Heart koufeta favours, a symbolic gift and a romantic turndown with sparkling wine and strawberries.
turn_offs_found.why: It sits under a heading about menus and drinks, so the heading doesn't match what I'm reading, and a nine-item sentence is hard to skim.

turn_offs_found.quote: Your Wedded Advisor quotes in AUD for Australian couples and confirms every inclusion in writing before you commit
turn_offs_found.why: Together with two Australian-only sections just above it, this makes me think the service isn't for me as someone in Singapore, so I'm less likely to bookmark or come back.

would_share_with: My engaged friend who's collecting quotes; I'd send her the 'How to compare two Santorini quotes like for like' checklist

cta_reaction.why: I don't have two quotes yet, I'm just looking. No pop-ups or walls, so no complaints, and I'd bookmark before I'd book. The AUD and Australian focus also makes me unsure they'd take me.

top_3_changes: Under 'Ceremony space, set-up and a coordinator', give each venue a one-line summary (guest number, hours, type of package) before the full inclusion list, or a short comparison table, so it can be skimmed on a phone.
Move the Andronis package inclusions out of 'Reception, menus and drinks' into the ceremony or elopement section, and break the list into bullets.
Phrase the AUD line in the CTA so it reads as a benefit for Australian couples rather than implying the service is only for Australians.
